verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's EC&VC practice page explicitly covers fundraising from seed and Series A through larger institutional/growth rounds and provides representative deals (N26 billion-dollar round, Flock from startup to £80m exit), which supports the core story. However, there is no stated aggregate deal volume (e.g., number of rounds closed per year) and only a couple of representative transactions are named rather than a fuller portfolio of priced-round examples across stages. Missing for 10: quantified deal volume/statistics, a broader list of representative priced-round transactions across seed through late stage, and independent corroboration of deal activity.
